name: Metalcraft Notes
description: Persona, skill, and HTTP API tools to save and manage markdown notes in Metalcraft Notes (notes.metalcraftai.com). Agent-first: the agent writes notes as plain markdown. One account owns many notebooks, each holding a tree of nested pages addressed by slug — list notebooks, create a notebook, list a notebook's page tree, get a page (markdown), create/update/delete pages (needs the write scope). Authenticated by a single Metalcraft account token — METALCRAFT_TOKEN, sent as Authorization: Bearer — the same token that works across every Metalcraft ecosystem app. The API base is fixed to https://notes.metalcraftai.com.
